title: VULCA-BENCH: A Multicultural Vision-Language Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Understanding
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks the interpretation of religious and spiritual traditions as part of its 'Cultural Symbolism' (L3) and 'Philosophical Aesthetics' (L5) layers. The benchmark includes datasets for Islamic art, Buddhist iconography (including specific mudras), and Western religious art, as well as evaluating concepts like 'bhakti' and 'Calvinist meditation' in its error analysis.
